name: Hani Tsuma Hs ~After Wedding~
original_name: はにつまHs ～アフターウェディング～
source:
This is the ero-filled fandisc for Hanitsuma. Hibiki’s relationship with his partner grows increasingly closer. To affirm his decision to his father, he proposed to her and their sweet married life begins.
